integrity.computer_role: Independent finite exact arithmetic regression only, not a substitute for the all-dimensional proof.
integrity.independent_certification: No independent audit or validation is asserted.
integrity.mathematical_claim: Sharp equality of sorting energy multiplier with maximum weighted prefix/minimum-cut ratio for every admissible convex edge density, plus centered defect formulas.
integrity.proof_method: Convex superadditivity, level-set crossing cuts, binary equality witnesses, exact weighted-cut enumeration.

scientific_limitations: Finite weighted paths, not arbitrary graphs or higher-dimensional rearrangements.
One-input convex edge-energy multiplier, not a two-input Lipschitz estimate.
The odd/even closed formulas require their specified symmetric central-defect patterns.
Related weighted-rearrangement and isoperimetric literature may contain equivalent implicit formulations.
title: Isoperimetric sharp constants for sorting in convex weighted-path energies
